Employee clearing account — Edit

This form configures the control account for employee clearing transactions.

The control account tracks amounts owed to or from employees.

Name

Enter the name of the control account. This name will appear on financial reports instead of individual employee names.

Code

Optionally, enter an account code. Codes help organize accounts and can be used for searching and sorting.

Group

Select the balance sheet group where this control account should appear. This determines its placement on the balance sheet.

Cash Flow Statement Group

Select the cash flow statement group for operating activities. This determines where employee-related cash flows appear on the cash flow statement.

Position

Set the position number to control the display order within the selected group. Lower numbers appear first.

Inactive

Mark this control account as inactive to prevent it from appearing in dropdown lists. Existing transactions will not be affected.
